atomic_operations.rule_zh: 后续每位persona至少有一条自然的三操作命令，无固定数量或比例；不能硬凑，匹配时寻找适合的组合。现有五位本轮不为凑数修改已合适的命令。

source_images.planning: Complete personas, profiles, instructions and exact per-image modification plans before generation.
source_images.generation: Generate source modifications only after the other construction steps; batch or concurrent generation may follow text-data publication.
source_images.internal: Retain upstream originals, intermediate images, final images and provenance.
source_images.external: Publish only the active source per task. Use the reviewed final modification when available; otherwise use the original and explicitly mark pending generation with the decided plan.
source_images.approval: User authorized four concurrent imagegen source modification requests on2026-10-20. Assistant strict precondition/visual review precedes final human review.
source_images.uniqueness: All1000 source images globally distinct, including compressed, resized and cropped variants; not just different file paths.
source_images.precondition_review: For every atomic edit verify the actual source does not already satisfy its result. Add requires a genuinely absent additional target, Move requires a distinct supported destination, Remove a visible target, and Replace/Attribute/Retouch/Background/Restyle a visible unsatisfied state. Flag uncertain or invisible changes and repair before human review; a task having another valid edit does not excuse a no-op.
source_images.post_generation_review: Recheck all targets, physical support, same-category competitors, preserved original identity and untouched future answers. Reground bounding boxes in the actual generated frame; include newly eligible distractors in removal complements.

authoring_review: Individually match, author and visually review eachpersona; inspect the completed cohort again before final handoff.
